01 / The idea

Web Design / Strategy

Which decisions determine the effort?

Two websites with the same page count can have very different technical and design requirements. Content, components, integrations, support and approval processes determine the work involved. We separate planning, content, design, development and ongoing operation, making it clear which services are needed and where the budget goes.

Prices can be compared only when the services are comparable.
02 / The composition

No flat figure without a defined scope.

The proposal clearly separates concept, content, design, technology and ongoing operation.

  1. 01Scope and priorities
  2. 02Custom features and integrations
  3. 03Content maintenance, hosting and ongoing development
03 / From concept to outcome

Actual effort,
not guesswork.

The price follows a verifiable scope of work, including design, content and later operation.

  1. 01

    Scope of work

    Which pages, languages, forms, integrations and editorial tasks are needed?

  2. 02

    Quality level

    How much work is needed for custom design, responsive states, accessibility and testing?

  3. 03

    Operating model

    Which costs are one-off, and which come from hosting, maintenance or ongoing optimisation?

04 / Recognising quality

Comparable proposals need the same foundation.

A clear proposal with defined services, assumptions and possible future stages, without invented flat prices.
